mechanism: Fluconazole inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, increasing albendazole metabolite (albendazole sulfoxide) concentrations and potentially enhancing both efficacy and toxicity.
action: Monitor for increased albendazole adverse effects (hepatotoxicity, bone marrow suppression); consider dose reduction of albendazole or use alternative antifungal if prolonged co-administration required.
